protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: PASS_WITH_SCOPE_CORRECTION: b47fa1c75d890cd080e3f6699bbfca8cd8d4b939 has human author/committer L1nSn0w and a Made-with: Cursor trailer, supporting AI_ROOT_CAUSE for the session-bypass constituent only. findings: The primary record internally acknowledges that dashboard and WebSocket sinks remain reachable at HEAD while nevertheless assigning fix_sha/direct_fix_sha=1b8c64d0da2f3df167502af72e95417a1c4578db and remaining_gap=null; those fields overstate a one-sink patch as the advisory's complete direct fix.

The vendor advisory explicitly describes three independent gaps and names logs, visitor stats, update info, user emails, SSE, and WebSocket impact. b47fa1c75d890cd080e3f6699bbfca8cd8d4b939 first-writes only the session-bypass constituent and cannot be used as the single atomic BIC for every named sink.

The public release claim is contradicted by repository state: v4.5.1 fixes GetAllUsers authorization but leaves the other advisory paths unchanged; the same incomplete state persists through v5.7.0 and current origin/main.

The authoritative CVE record is PUBLISHED and the vendor advisory is not withdrawn, so this is not FALSE_POSITIVE; the required correction concerns attribution scope and incomplete remediation, not advisory validity.

corrected_fields.flaw_origin: b47fa1c75d890cd080e3f6699bbfca8cd8d4b939 is the atomic BIC only for the RequireScopes session-token early-return constituent. The aggregate advisory also contains independently introduced missing-handler and middleware-free sink defects and therefore has no single demonstrated atomic BIC.
corrected_fields.scope_statement: AI_ROOT_CAUSE attribution is limited to the session-token early return first written by b47fa1c75d890cd080e3f6699bbfca8cd8d4b939 and carried to main by squash 3f8fb150158723aca31df2ae937a1aa7b31ac254; it does not attribute the pre-existing or later sink introductions to AI.
corrected_fields.remaining_gap: No complete direct-fix commit or fixed release was verified for all advisory-named sinks. 1b8c64d0da2f3df167502af72e95417a1c4578db is only a partial GetAllUsers fix; v4.5.1, v5.7.0, and origin/main aa0fae7980a58bec93557827c4929d3b197724dd retain the remaining bypasses.

remaining_gap: A complete remediation SHA and first fully fixed release do not exist in the examined public refs; the record must remain explicitly unpatched for the non-GetAllUsers sinks.
